Tools

ARIA’s modular tool system for interacting with various services and data sources.

Base Tool

Base infrastructure for ARIA tools.

This module provides the foundational classes for building tools that the agent can use, including risk classification, result handling, and schema validation.

class aria.tools.base.RiskLevel(*values)[source]

Bases: str, Enum

Risk level classification for tool operations.

Tools are classified by their potential impact, determining whether they require user approval before execution.

LOW = 'low'
MEDIUM = 'medium'
HIGH = 'high'
CRITICAL = 'critical'
property requires_confirmation: bool

Check if this risk level requires user confirmation.

Returns:

True if confirmation is required

Return type:

bool

property requires_double_confirmation: bool

Check if this risk level requires double confirmation.

Returns:

True if double confirmation is required

Return type:

bool

__str__()[source]

String representation of risk level.

Return type:

str

class aria.tools.base.BaseTool[source]

Bases: ABC, Generic[TParams]

Abstract base class for all ARIA tools.

Tools are the primary way the agent interacts with the world. Each tool defines its parameters, risk level, and execution logic.

Subclasses must implement: - execute() - The actual tool logic - get_confirmation_message() - Human-readable description for approval

Type Parameters:

TParams: Pydantic model defining the tool’s parameters

name: str
description: str
risk_level: RiskLevel
parameters_schema: type[BaseModel]
__init__()[source]

Initialize the tool.

Validates that required class attributes are set.

property requires_confirmation: bool

Check if this tool requires user confirmation.

Returns:

True if confirmation is required based on risk level

Return type:

bool

property requires_double_confirmation: bool

Check if this tool requires double confirmation.

Returns:

True if double confirmation is required

Return type:

bool

Document Tools

Document Processing

Document processor orchestrating the full processing pipeline.

class aria.tools.documents.processor.DocumentProcessor(ocr_tool, classifier, settings)[source]

Bases: object

Orchestrates the document processing pipeline.

This class coordinates OCR extraction, LLM classification, filename generation, and destination path construction.

Parameters:

  • ocr_tool (OCRTool)

  • classifier (DocumentClassifier)

  • settings (Settings)

__init__(ocr_tool, classifier, settings)[source]

Initialize the processor.

Parameters:

  • ocr_tool (OCRTool) – OCR tool for text extraction

  • classifier (DocumentClassifier) – Document classifier using LLM

  • settings (Settings) – ARIA settings for output paths

async process_document(source_path)[source]

Process a scanned document through the full pipeline.

Pipeline steps: 1. Run OCR to extract text 2. Use LLM to classify (person, category, date, sender, summary) 3. Generate suggested filename 4. Construct destination path

Parameters:

source_path (Path) – Path to the PDF or image file

Return type:

ProcessedDocument

Returns:

ProcessedDocument with all extracted information

Raises:

RuntimeError – If any step of the pipeline fails

generate_filename(classification, original_name)[source]

Generate a descriptive filename for the document.

Format: {YYYY-MM-DD}_{sender_slug}_{category}.pdf

Examples: - 2025-01-15_kaiser_permanente_medical.pdf - 2025-01-10_lincoln_elementary_education.pdf - 2025-01-20_pg_and_e_utilities.pdf

If no date found, use today’s date. Sender name is slugified (lowercase, underscores, no special chars).

Parameters:

  • classification (ClassificationResult) – Classification result with metadata

  • original_name (str) – Original filename (for extension)

Return type:

str

Returns:

Generated filename

get_destination_path(person, category, filename)[source]

Construct the full destination path.

Format: {output_dir}/{person_lower}/{category}/{filename}

Example: ~/documents/amir/medical/2025-01-15_kaiser_permanente_medical.pdf

Parameters:

  • person (str) – Family member name

  • category (str) – Document category

  • filename (str) – Generated filename

Return type:

Path

Returns:

Full destination path

Scanner Tools

Scan and Index

Integrated document scanning and indexing tool.

This module provides a unified tool that scans a directory for documents, processes them with OCR and classification, organizes them into an archive, and indexes them for semantic search.

class aria.tools.scanner.scan_and_index.ScanAndIndexTool(processor, ingester, archive_index, settings)[source]

Bases: BaseTool[ScanAndIndexParams]

Scan directory, process documents, and index them for semantic search.

This tool provides the complete document processing pipeline: 1. Scans source directory for PDF files 2. Processes each document:

  • Runs OCR to extract text

  • Uses LLM to classify (person, category, date, sender, summary, tags)

  • Generates intelligent filename

  1. Organizes the file: - Copies to archive directory with structured path

  2. Indexes for search: - Ingests into ChromaDB with metadata - Adds to archive index database

  3. Moves original: - Moves original file to processed directory (after confirmation)

Risk Level: MEDIUM - Copies files to archive, modifies ChromaDB, moves originals

Parameters:

  • processor (DocumentProcessor)

  • ingester (DocumentIngester)

  • archive_index (ArchiveIndex)

  • settings (Settings)

name: str = 'scan_and_index'
description: str = 'Scan a directory for documents, process them with OCR and classification, organize into archive, and index for semantic search. Complete end-to-end document processing pipeline.'
risk_level: RiskLevel = 'medium'

Deduplicate

Deduplication tool for checking and moving already-processed documents.

This module provides functionality to check if files in the source directory have already been processed and exist in the archive. Duplicates are moved to the processed_originals_directory to avoid re-processing.

class aria.tools.scanner.deduplicate.DeduplicateTool(archive_index, settings)[source]

Bases: BaseTool[DeduplicateParams]

Check source directory for already-processed files and delete duplicates.

This tool helps prevent re-processing of documents by: 1. Scanning source directory for files 2. Checking if they already exist in the archive (by filename or hash) 3. Deleting duplicates from source directory (since they’re already safely archived)

Risk Level: MEDIUM - Deletes duplicate files from source directory

Parameters:

  • archive_index (ArchiveIndex)

  • settings (Settings)

name: str = 'deduplicate'
description: str = 'Check source directory for files that have already been processed and delete duplicates to avoid re-processing. Can check by filename (fast) or file hash (thorough).'
